hypothesis: Picking the MTP head's draft and its probability on the device, in the head's frame, instead of bringing the 248320 logits down and scanning them twice on the host, takes about 2 ms off each draft and raises Qwen3.6's decode with the head's drafts on an L4 with every expert in VRAM, with the same logits.
